 Order

This petition is filed praying to quash the FIR in Crime No.125/2023 of Vidyanagar Police Station registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code (hereinafter referred to as 'the IPC', for short) (PC No.1721/2023 on the file of the learned I Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Hubballi).
2. Respondent No.2 filed PC No.1721/2023 against the petitioner for the offences under Section 406 and 420 of IPC.

The said complaint came to be referred to the Police for investigation and the Vidyanagar Police have registered a case in Crime No.125/2023 against this petitioner for offences under Section 406 and 420 of IPC.
The petitioner has sought for quashing of the said FIR in Crime No.125/2023 of Vidyanagar Police Station.
An application is filed under Section 320 read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure which is jointly signed by the petitioner and respondent No.2 and their respective counsels.

The said application is supported by the affidavit of respondent No.2.
4.
The petitioner is the husband and respondent No.2 is his wife.
The marriage of the petitioner with respondent No.2 has been dissolved in O.S. No.39/2022 in view of the settlement dated 12.10.2023.
In terms of the said Memorandum of Settlement, respondent No.2 has no objection for quashing of the FIR in Crime No.125/2023 of Vidyanagar Police Station, Hubballi.
